name: Meganobz
legend: Mega armour comprises massive slabs of metal bashed roughly into shape, and is powered by pistons and sheer brute strength. It is highly resilient and can mount an array of potent weaponry. It is also usually worn to battle by toof-rich Nobz who would be scary enough even were they not each wearing their own Ork-portable bunker.
loadout: Every model is equipped with: kustom shoota; power klaw.

faction.name: Waaagh!
faction.description_html:
If your Army Faction is ORKS, once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can call a Waaagh!. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, the Waaagh! is active for your army and:
  • Units from your army with this ability are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced.
  • Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models from your army with this ability.
  • Models from your army with this ability have a 5+ invulnerable save.

datasheet.name: Krumpin’ Time
datasheet.description_html: While the Waaagh! is active for your army, models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

wargear_options.description:
Any number of models can each have their kustom shoota and power klaw replaced with one of the following:
  • 1 kombi-weapon and 1 power klaw
  • 1 kombi-weapon and 1 killsaw
  • 1 kustom shoota and 1 killsaw
  • 1 killsaw and 1 power klaw
  • 1 twin killsaw

detachment_abilities.name: Da Boss Is Watchin’
detachment_abilities.description_html: At the start of your Command phase, in a turn in which you have not called a Waaagh!, if you have one or more Warboss models on the battlefield (or embarked within a Transport that is on the battlefield), you can call a Waaagh! for a second time this battle. When doing so, that second Waaagh! only counts as having been called for WARBOSS, Nobz and Meganobz units from your army.

detachment_abilities.name: Comin’ Through
detachment_abilities.description_html: In your Movement phase, Desperate Escape tests taken for ORKS models from your army are automatically passed and each time an ORKS unit from your army makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through other models as if they were not there, provided those other models have a lower Toughness characteristic than it.

detachment_abilities.name: Here Be Loot
detachment_abilities.description_html:
At the start of your Command phase, select one objective marker. Until the start of your next Command phase, that objective marker is your loot objective.

Each time a model in an Orks Infantry, Orks Mounted or Orks Walker unit from your army makes an attack, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability if either or both of the following are true:
  • That model’s unit is within range of your loot objective.
  • That attack targets a unit within range of your loot objective.

detachment_abilities.name: Eager for the Fight
detachment_abilities.description_html: Each time an ORKS unit from your army disembarks from a Transport, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for that ORKS unit.
